title: Technical & Creative Content Writer - B2B
description:
**Technical & Creative Content Writer - B2B**

**Location:** Hyderabad, Onsite  
**Experience:** 2 to 6 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

**About The Smarketers**

The Smarketers is a B2B marketing agency that works with technology companies to help them build their brand, generate demand, and grow their business.

We work with clients across SaaS, IT Services, Manufacturing, Industrial Automation, Telecom, Healthcare, ERP, FinTech, and other technology-driven B2B industries.

Content is one of the key pillars of what we do. We create blogs, eBooks, whitepapers, case studies, website content, social media content, brochures, reports, video scripts, and other marketing and sales content.

**About the Role**

**Do you understand technology and have a flair for creative writing?Can you turn complex B2B technology and business topics into content that people want to read?**

If yes, that is what we are looking for.

As a **Technical & Creative Content Writer - B2B**, you will plan, research, create, and edit content for our B2B technology clients.

You will work across different industries and need to understand the client's business, products, technology, customers, industry, competitors, and positioning before creating content. You should be able to understand both the **technical and business side** of a product and turn complex topics into clear, engaging, and relevant content for B2B audiences.

You will create content for different stages of the B2B buyer journey, from building awareness and educating audiences to generating interest, supporting demand generation, and helping move prospects towards a buying decision.

The role also requires a good understanding of how B2B content is discovered and consumed through search engines, answer engines, and AI-powered search.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Understand the client's business, products, services, technology, industry, customers, decision-makers, competitors, positioning, and tone of voice.
* Research B2B industries, companies, technologies, and customer challenges to develop relevant content.
* Understand the client's target audience and create content around their business challenges, questions, pain points, and buying considerations.
* Write, edit, and manage technical and creative B2B content across different platforms and formats.
* Create blogs, website content, case studies, eBooks, whitepapers, reports, brochures, social media content, email content, video scripts, and other marketing and sales assets.
* Develop content ideas and recommendations based on business objectives, audience needs, industry trends, customer challenges, and search behaviour.
* Create content outlines and content plans for client and in-house requirements.
* Develop thought leadership and research-driven content for B2B technology audiences.
* Create content for different stages of the B2B buyer journey and support inbound marketing and demand generation campaigns.
* Adapt writing style, tone, messaging, and level of technical detail based on the client, industry, audience, and content format.
* Apply SEO best practices while developing content, including search intent, keyword usage, content structure, headings, internal linking, and long-tail keywords.
* Understand AEO and how content can be structured to answer questions clearly and effectively.
* Understand how B2B audiences are increasingly discovering information through AI-powered search and LLMs and apply relevant content practices.
* Review and improve existing content based on relevance, readability, search intent, and audience engagement.
* Edit, proofread, fact-check, and quality check content before delivery.
* Work with subject matter experts, clients, Account Managers, SEO, Design, and other internal teams to develop the required content.
* Ensure content is original, well researched, factually accurate, and aligned with the client's business and marketing objectives.
* Use AI tools where appropriate to support research, brainstorming, information gathering, editing, and improving productivity and speed.
* Take ownership of content deliverables and ensure they are completed within agreed timelines.
* Stay updated on B2B industries, technology, content marketing, SEO, search trends, and new content formats.

**Requirements**

* 2 to 6 years of relevant experience in B2B content writing, technical writing, technology content, or a similar role.
* Strong writing skills with the ability to create both technical and creative B2B content.
* Ability to understand technology, business concepts, products, and services and explain them in simple, clear, and engaging language.
* Strong understanding of B2B audiences, decision-makers, buying journeys, and business challenges.
* Strong research skills and the ability to quickly understand new industries, technologies, products, and businesses.
* Good understanding of B2B content marketing and inbound marketing.
* Good understanding of SEO, search intent, keyword research, and content optimization.
* Working knowledge of AEO and awareness of AI-powered search and LLM-based content discovery.
* Ability to create content that is optimized for search without compromising creativity, readability, or the reader's experience.
* Excellent grammar, editing, proofreading, and communication skills.
* Ability to write in different styles, from technical and informative to creative, conversational, and thought leadership content.
* Good command of US and British English.
* Ability to manage multiple client projects and deadlines without compromising quality.
* Self-motivated, curious, and willing to learn new industries and technologies.
* Strong attention to detail and ownership of work.
* Experience writing for SaaS, IT Services, Manufacturing, Industrial Automation, Telecom, Healthcare, ERP, FinTech, or similar B2B industries is preferred.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating technical, creative, B2B, or thought leadership content is preferred.

**Tools & Platforms**

Familiarity with the following is preferred:

* **Content & Research:** Google Search, Google Trends, keyword research and content research tools
* **SEO & Content Optimization:** Semrush, Ahrefs, or similar tools
* **Content Management:** WordPress or other CMS platforms
* **AI Tools:** ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, or similar tools for research, brainstorming, information gathering, editing, and improving productivity
* **Collaboration:** Google Docs, Google Sheets, and similar tools

AI tools should be used as a **supporting tool for research, speed, and efficiency**, not as a replacement for independent thinking, research, or writing. Strong writing ability, research skills, and subject understanding are essential.

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for someone who can **understand technology, think from a B2B customer's perspective, and write content that is both technically sound and creatively engaging.**

Someone who can take a complex product, understand why it matters to the customer's business, identify what the audience needs to know, and turn it into content that educates, engages, builds credibility, and supports the client's marketing goals.

**Salary:** Industry Standards

Pay: ₹400,000.00 - ₹600,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Hyderabad, Telangana: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Application Question(s):

* How many years of experience do you have in B2B content writing?
* Do you have experience writing technical content for technology, SaaS, IT Services, or other B2B companies?
* Do you have hands-on experience writing blogs, whitepapers, eBooks, case studies, website content, or other B2B marketing content?
* Do you have experience using tools such as Semrush, Ahrefs, or similar SEO/content research tools?
* Do you have 2–6 years of professional experience in B2B content writing, technical writing, or technology content?
* How many years of experience do you have in technical content writing?
* How many years of experience do you have in content marketing?
* How many years of experience do you have using AI tools for content-related work?
* Do you have experience using AI tools for content editing, rewriting, and improving readability?
* Have you used AI tools to generate content briefs, outlines, or topic ideas?
* What is your expected CTC?

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Language:

* English (Required)

Location:

* Hyderabad, Telangana (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Expert Scientific Writer HEVA
description:
**Job title: Expert Scientific Writer – Health Economics and Value Assessment (HEVA)**

* **Hiring Manager: Head/Group Lead/Team Lead HEVA**
* **Location: Hyderabad**

**About the job**

**Our Team:**

Sanofi Global Hub (SGH) is an internal Sanofi resource organization based in India and is setup to centralize processes and activities to support Specialty Care, Vaccines, General Medicines, CHC, CMO, and R&D, Data & Digital functions. SGH strives to be a strategic and functional partner for tactical deliveries to Medical, HEVA, and Commercial organizations in Sanofi, Globally.

**Main responsibilities:**

The overall purpose and main responsibilities are listed below:

Create HEVA communication deliverables (including manuscripts, posters, abstracts, slide decks) aligned with HEVA strategy and global HEVA communication plan across relevant business units and product teams. Contribute to execution of HEVA communication plans with relevant medical communication plans to ensure evidence needs for healthcare decision makers are consistently identified and prioritized in communication plans, supporting integrated clinical and health economic evidence in support of the value of products. Manage core HEVA communication processes, templates, and products across the portfolio in accordance with the scientific and value messages aligned with Core Value Dossier, the US AMCP Dossier, and HEVA contributions as appropriate to other submissions. Ensure Core Value Decks for key products are established and maintained, making available a regularly updated synthesis of critical HEVA evidence on the value of products. Maintain accountability for adherence to the publication standard operating procedure (SOP) and other compliance expectations relevant to HEVA communication processes. Seek opportunities to innovate HEVA value communications to increase the relevance and impact of HEVA evidence and inform optimal access and reimbursement decisions. Create complex and specialized content without supervision. Develop and maintain therapeutic area expertise. Coach senior and junior HEVA writers and develop and review content created by them. Manage end to end process iEnvision (previously, Datavision/Matrix). Collaborate effectively with stakeholders: HEVA, RWE, and Scientific communication global and/or local teams.

  

* People: (1) Maintain effective relationships with the end stakeholders (Medical scientific community) within the allocated GBU and product – with an end objective to develop education and communication content as per requirement for HEVA communications; (2) Interact effectively with healthcare professionals on publication content; and (3) Constantly assist writers (senior or junior) in developing knowledge and sharing expertise

  

* Performance: (1) Create HEVA communications deliverables (including manuscripts, posters, abstracts, and slide decks) aligned with HEVA strategy and global HEVA communication plan across relevant business units and product teams as per agreed timelines and quality; and (2) Provide strategic support with individuals and institutions, which may serve as resources for publications purpose, etc

  

* Process: (1) Develop complex publications material; (2) Act as an expert in the field of medical communication for the assigned therapeutic area; (3) Assist the assigned scientific communication team in conducting comprehensive publication-needs analysis; (4) Manage core HEVA communication processes, templates, and products across the portfolio in accordance with the scientific and value messages aligned with Core Value Dossier, the US AMCP Dossier, and HEVA contributions as appropriate to other submissions; (5) Ensure Core Value Decks for key products are established and maintained, making available a regularly updated synthesis of critical HEVA evidence on the value of products; (6) Maintain accountability for adherence to the publication SOP and other compliance expectations relevant to HEVA communication processes; (7) Maintain accountability for adherence to the publication SOP and other compliance expectations relevant to HEVA communication processes; (8) Implement the publication plan and associated activities for the year identified for the region; (9) Work with selected vendors within the region to deliver the required deliverables as per defined process; (10) Leverage advanced training delivery tools and techniques thereby enhancing the effectiveness of training delivery; and (11) Design an overall plan of action based on end-user feedback and improve course content and delivery

  

* Stakeholder: (1) Work closely with HEVA global and local teams, RWE global and local teams and scientific communication teams in regions/areas to identify publications needs and assist in developing assigned deliverables; and (2) Liaise with HEVA global and local teams to prepare relevant and customized deliverables

About you

* **Experience**: 7+ years of experience in content creation for the pharmaceutical/healthcare industry, or academia
* **Soft skills**: Stakeholder management; communication skills; and ability to work independently and within a team environment
* **Technical skills**: Relevant training/experience in health economics, public health, epidemiology, or other relevant health-related scientific discipline (including but not limited to therapeutic area/domain knowledge exposure; knowledge of Good Publication Practice; publication submission; and/or project management)
* **Education**: Advanced degree in life sciences/pharmacy/similar discipline or medical degree
* **Languages**: Excellent knowledge of English language (spoken and written)

title: Senior Manager, AIN Documentation, Content Create and Automation (DCCA)
description:
India - Hyderabad

JOB ID: R-258450 LOCATION: India - Hyderabad WORK LOCATION TYPE: On Site DATE POSTED: Oct. 14, 2026 CATEGORY: Manufacturing

**Senior Manager, AIN Documentation, Content Create and Automation (DCCA)**

Location: India | Scope: Global service supporting Amgen sites

Under minimal direction, the Senior Manager, DCCA leads a DS, DP or FDP team based in India that creates and revises controlled GMP documentation for Amgen sites globally. The role owns the service-delivery model that enables reliable, compliant, and accurate documentation support - delivering to agreed service-level agreements while driving right-first-time quality, predictable turnaround, and continuous improvement. Hours for this role may vary based on global time zones, which could include hybrid hours, on call requirements, and flexible working hours.

**Role Responsibilities**
=========================

**Global Service Delivery and SLA Management**

* Lead the daily operation of the global GMP documentation service for DS, DP, or FDP, ensuring requests are received, clarified, prioritized, assigned, completed, and handed off in accordance with defined service-level agreements.

* Establish transparent intake, triage, prioritization, and escalation practices that balance site criticality, compliance risk, business impact, and available capacity.

* Develop and maintain capacity plans, workload forecasts, staffing models, and recovery plans that enable the team to meet commitments across supported sites and time zones.

* Own performance management routines and dashboards for on-time delivery, right-first-time quality, cycle time, queue aging, rework, customer feedback, and resource utilization.

* Identify service risks early, communicate impacts and options clearly, and escalate constraints with proposed mitigation and recovery actions.

**GMP Documentation Quality and Compliance**

* Ensure document creation and revision activities comply with applicable global and local GMP requirements, good documentation practices, data-integrity expectations, controlled-document procedures, and approved change-control processes.

* Set and maintain standards for document structure, technical writing, accuracy, traceability, version control, formatting, and review readiness to prevent defects before delivery.

* Oversee authoring and revision of controlled GMP documents, such as SOPs, work instructions, forms, manufacturing and laboratory records, technical reports, and associated attachments, based on approved site inputs and change requirements.

* Oversee the content creation of training materials used in the manufacturing areas including instructional design.

* Implement appropriate peer review, quality checks, training, and escalation mechanisms to improve right-first-time acceptance and reduce avoidable rework.

* Support inspection and audit readiness; ensure service records, training, and performance evidence are complete, traceable, and review-ready.

* Oversee investigational support within the specific manufacturing domain.

**Global Partnership and Governance**

* Serve as the senior-manager-level liaison between the India documentation team and global site stakeholders, including Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering, QC, Regulatory, Supply Chain, and other technical functions.

* Create effective governance forums with supported sites to review demand, priorities, service performance, quality trends, capacity needs, and improvement opportunities.

* Clarify and maintain accountability between the service team and site owners: the service team provides disciplined document development and revision support; site functions retain ownership of technical content, approvals, local requirements, and implementation decisions.

* Resolve complex cross-functional issues that could affect document quality, approval readiness, delivery timing, or compliance, using a risk-based approach.

**People Leadership and Organizational Capability**

* Recruit, develop, coach, and retain a high-performing team of GMP documentation professionals, technical writers, and/or documentation specialists.

* Establish role clarity, training curricula, performance expectations, career paths, and succession plans that build sustainable technical and leadership capability in India.

* Promote a culture of quality, ownership, collaboration, customer focus, and continuous learning while maintaining an inclusive, respectful, and accountable work environment.

* Partner with Human Resources and functional leaders to maintain an adaptable organization that can respond to changing global demand and business priorities.

**Operational Excellence and Strategic Improvement**

* Standardize and continuously improve documentation workflows, templates, authoring practices, quality controls, and digital ways of working across the service.

* Lead cross-site projects and improvement initiatives that increase speed, accuracy, scalability, and customer experience without compromising compliance.

* Manage departmental headcount, training, technology, and operating budgets; optimize resources against the long-range demand plan.

* Represent the documentation service on global teams, task forces, and quality-system initiatives as needed.

**Service Performance and Quality Measures**
============================================

The leader establishes goals and management routines that keep customer commitments, documentation quality, and compliance visible and balanced.

**Measure**

**Leadership expectation**

**On-time delivery**

Meet committed site service-level agreements through active planning, workload balancing, and early escalation of risks.

**Right-first-time quality**

Increase documents accepted without material rework by applying defined authoring standards, peer review, and quality checks before handoff.

**Cycle time and queue health**

Monitor turnaround time, aging, backlog, and prioritization to maintain a predictable global service.

**Compliance performance**

Maintain adherence to controlled-document, change-control, data-integrity, training, and audit-readiness requirements.

**Customer partnership and capacity**

Use site feedback, demand forecasts, and workload data to improve service reliability and plan resource needs.

*Service-level targets and acceptance criteria are defined in collaboration with the supported sites and governing quality processes.*

**Basic Qualifications**
========================

Bachelor's degree and 12 to 17 years of experience

2 years of managerial experience directly managing people and/or leadership experience leading teams, projects, programs, or directing the allocation of resources.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Bachelor's degree in life sciences, engineering, technical communications, business, or a related field.

* 7+ years of directly related experience in a biotechnology, pharmaceutical, medical-device, or other regulated GMP environment, including 4+ years leading people, technical writers, documentation specialists, projects, or programs.

* Demonstrated experience developing and revising controlled GMP documents, including SOPs, work instructions, forms, manufacturing or laboratory records, and related technical documentation.

* Experience operating a shared service or customer-facing function across multiple sites, cultures, and time zones, with accountability for service-level agreements and delivery metrics.

* Experience with electronic document-management and quality-management systems, document lifecycles, change control, and inspection or audit support.

* Lean, continuous-improvement, project-management, or operational-excellence experience is preferred.

**Core Competencies**
=====================

* Strong people leadership, coaching, talent development, and capability building for a diverse technical team.

* Expert technical writing, editing, and review skills; sound judgment to distinguish content clarity, document quality, and compliance risk.

* In-depth knowledge of cGMP, good documentation practices, data integrity principles, controlled-document requirements, and change-management processes.

* Service-management discipline: intake, prioritization, workload planning, capacity modeling, performance dashboards, and timely risk escalation.

* Ability to influence global stakeholders, resolve competing priorities, communicate clearly in writing and verbally, and operate effectively across time zones.

* Analytical problem solving, continuous-improvement mindset, strong attention to detail, and the ability to manage change without compromising quality while demonstrating a commitment to safety, quality, integrity, and Amgen values.

title: Proposal Writer
description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONTendering Executive / Tendering Engineer

**Company:** Exodrone Systems  
**Location:** Hyderabad, Telangana  
**Department:** Business Development / Tendering  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

1. Job Summary

Exodrone Systems is looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Tendering Executive / Tendering Engineer to identify, evaluate, prepare, and submit tenders for drone manufacturing, UAV systems, surveillance solutions, agricultural drones, defence applications, and other government and industrial projects.

The candidate will be responsible for managing the complete tendering process, from identifying suitable opportunities on government portals to preparing technical and commercial bids, coordinating documentation, and tracking tender results.

2. Key Responsibilities

**A. Tender Identification and Opportunity Research**

* Identify relevant tenders on GeM, CPPP, eProcurement portals, state government portals, defence procurement portals, and other platforms.
* Search for opportunities related to drones, UAVs, drone services, surveillance systems, agriculture, surveying, manufacturing, and defence technology.
* Evaluate tender eligibility, EMD, turnover requirements, prior experience, technical qualifications, and submission deadlines.
* Maintain a database of upcoming, ongoing, and submitted tenders.

**B. Tender Documentation and Submission**

* Prepare and submit technical bids, commercial bids, and supporting documents.
* Review tender documents, RFPs, BOQs, eligibility criteria, and technical specifications.
* Prepare compliance statements, technical datasheets, declarations, undertakings, and other required documents.
* Coordinate the preparation of company profiles, GST certificates, PAN, MSME/Udyam certificates, financial statements, work orders, and experience certificates.
* Ensure all tender submissions are complete, accurate, and submitted before deadlines.
* Manage online bid submission, document uploads, digital signatures, and portal-related formalities.

**C. Technical and Commercial Coordination**

* Coordinate with the engineering team to prepare technical specifications and compliance matrices.
* Obtain quotations from vendors and suppliers for components, equipment, and third-party products.
* Prepare cost sheets, BOQs, pricing comparisons, and commercial proposals.
* Coordinate internally to ensure that proposed products meet the tender requirements.
* Flag deviations, restrictive specifications, missing certifications, and risks before bid submission.

**D. Government and Institutional Liaison**

* Track tender clarifications, pre-bid meetings, corrigenda, amendments, and submission extensions.
* Prepare responses to buyer queries and requests for additional documentation.
* Coordinate with government departments, PSUs, defence organisations, and institutional buyers wherever required.
* Track technical evaluation, financial bid opening, results, purchase orders, and contract requirements.

**E. Tender Pipeline and Reporting**

* Maintain an updated tender tracker with deadlines, estimated values, eligibility, bid status, and outcomes.
* Prepare weekly reports on identified opportunities, submitted bids, and upcoming deadlines.
* Maintain an organised digital archive of tender documents and previous submissions.
* Analyse unsuccessful bids and recommend improvements to future submissions.

3. Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Engineering, Business Administration, Commerce, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of experience in tendering, government procurement, or bid management preferred.
* Freshers with strong documentation, research, and computer skills may also apply.
* Experience with GeM, CPPP, eProcurement portals, or government tender submissions is preferred.

4. Required Skills

* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong documentation, research, and organisational abilities.
* Working knowledge of MS Excel, Word, PDF tools, and online procurement portals.
* Ability to understand technical specifications and eligibility conditions.
* Strong attention to detail and deadline management.
* Ability to coordinate with engineering, accounts, vendors, and management teams.
* Knowledge of GST, EMD, bid security, performance security, and government procurement procedures is an advantage.

5. Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Number of relevant tenders identified and evaluated.
* Number of eligible tenders submitted before deadlines.
* Accuracy and completeness of tender documentation.
* Tender qualification and technical acceptance rate.
* Number and value of orders won.
* Timely tracking of tender updates, clarifications, and results.

6. Preferred Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be proactive, disciplined, comfortable working with government procurement portals, and capable of independently managing multiple tenders. Experience in drone technology, aerospace, defence equipment, electronics, engineering products, or industrial manufacturing will be an added advantage.

7. Compensation

Salary: As per experience and capabilities.

8. How to Apply

Interested candidates may submit their resume highlighting relevant tendering experience, government procurement portal knowledge, and previous tender submissions.

**Email:** info@exosl.com  
**Company:** Exodrone Systems, Hyderabad

Pay: ₹11,000.00 - ₹64,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Change Management Lead
description:
**Job Information**

**Job Description**
-------------------

At Prolifics, we are currently implementing multiple solutions, and we are looking to hire Change Management Lead for our development centre in India. This position would be based out of Hyderabad and is a permanent position.

If you are looking for a high growth company with rock-solid stability, if you thrive in the energetic atmosphere of high-profile projects, we want to talk to you today! Let’s connect and explore possibilities of having you onboard the Prolifics team!

Job Title: Change Management Lead

Primary Skill: Lead change management activities across technology, product, process, and organizational transformation initiatives.  
Secondary Skill: Assess the business and organizational impact of proposed changes across different user groups and functions.  
Location: Hyderabad
  
Educational Qualification: B.Tech/BE/M.Tech/MCA/M.Sc  
YOE: 5-10 yrs

**Job Description:**

We are looking for an experienced Change Management professional to lead organizational change initiatives associated with technology implementations, product launches, process transformations, and business change programs.

The role will be responsible for assessing the impact of change, preparing stakeholders and end users, developing communication and training strategies, managing adoption, and ensuring that changes are successfully embedded into day-to-day operations.

The ideal candidate will have strong stakeholder management, communication, training, and organizational change skills, with the ability to work across business, technology, product, and delivery teams.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead change management activities across technology, product, process, and organizational transformation initiatives.
* Assess the business and organizational impact of proposed changes across different user groups and functions.
* Develop and execute comprehensive Change Management and Adoption Plans.
* Identify impacted stakeholders, user groups, processes, systems, and business functions.
* Develop stakeholder maps and assess stakeholder readiness, influence, impact, and potential resistance.
* Partner with business leaders, Product Owners, Project Managers, Technology teams, HR, Training, and Communications teams.
* Develop effective communication strategies and messaging for different stakeholder groups.
* Create and manage communication materials including announcements, newsletters, FAQs, presentations, executive updates, and change notifications.
* Develop training and enablement strategies aligned with the change roadmap.
* Coordinate training, demonstrations, workshops, knowledge-transfer sessions, and user enablement activities.
* Work with Technical Writers and Product Trainers to ensure documentation and training materials are aligned with the new processes and product capabilities.
* Establish stakeholder engagement plans and conduct regular readiness and feedback sessions.
* Identify potential resistance to change and develop appropriate mitigation and engagement strategies.
* Monitor adoption, user readiness, training completion, and change effectiveness.
* Develop and track change readiness and adoption metrics.
* Gather feedback from users and stakeholders and use insights to improve adoption.
* Support UAT, pilot programs, rollout planning, go-live, and post-production stabilization.
* Develop transition and operational-readiness plans to ensure smooth movement from project delivery to business-as-usual operations.
* Coordinate change activities across multiple locations, business units, and geographically distributed teams.
* Maintain change management risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and action items.
* Provide regular status updates and executive-level reporting on change readiness, adoption, risks, and key actions.
* Establish reusable change management frameworks, templates, processes, and best practices.

**About us:**

**Prolifics Corporation Limited** is a Global Technology Solutions Provider with presence across North America (USA and Canada), Europe (UK and Germany), Middle East & Asia. In India, we have offshore development centers: 3 in Hyderabad & 1 in Pune.

For more than 40 years, Prolifics has transformed enterprises of all sizes including over 100 Fortune 1000 companies by solving their complex IT challenges. Our clients include Fortune 50 and Fortune 100 companies across a broad range of industries including Financial Services, Insurance, Government, Healthcare, Telecommunications, Manufacturing and Retail. We rank consistently in **Dream Companies to Work For**and**Dream Employer of the Year**ranking from World HRD Congress, ranked 7 in 2019.

We encourage you to visit us on **www.prolifics.com** or follow us on Twitter, LinkedIn, Facebook, YouTube and other social media to know more about us.

title: DOM Specialist
description:
**Job title: DOM Specialist**

* **Location:** Hyderabad

**About the job**


Sanofi is a global life sciences company committed to improving access to healthcare and supporting the people we serve throughout the continuum of care. From prevention to treatment, Sanofi transforms scientific innovation into healthcare solutions, in human vaccines, rare diseases, multiple sclerosis, oncology, immunology, infectious diseases, diabetes and cardiovascular solutions. As a company with a global vision of drug development and a highly regarded corporate culture, Sanofi is recognized as one of the best pharmaceutical companies in the world and is pioneering the application of Artificial Intelligence (AI) with strong commitment to develop advanced data standards to increase reusability \& interoperability and thus accelerate impact on global health.


The Workday Solutions Support Manager plays a critical role in the maintenance, development, and implementation of HR IS systems and the support of integrations for the downstream target systems. They are also key in helping to identify automation solutions and in participating on projects at a regional/global level, either as a member or as a leader. The scope includes recruitment, hiring \& onboarding, termination \& offboarding, talent management \& development and Your Voice surveys as well as projects as part of the Workday roadmap, Global/local Workday projects or Global/local projects connected to Workday as a source system.


The People Services Tech Solutions team is a team of experts that helps Operations through global technologies such as Workday, Appical, Peakon, and iLearn.

**Main responsibilities:**

* Participate as strong support based on Workday, Peakon, Appical expertise domains to improve the user experience for P\&C, Managers and Employees in the frame of our target operating model. Provide Level 2 functional and technical support and follow through to resolution in an effective and timely manner Understand change requirements at global and regional levels and translate them into actionable process and system changes. Conduct impact and root cause analysis, manage communications, and influence decisions to align with the support model and the business strategic objectives. Initiate change requests, test and implement system updates.
* Liaise with key stakeholders to identify pain points and implement sustainable solutions to ensure a high level of quality for Core HR master data. Assess and test new functional enhancements for semi\-annual releases. Support for Global Processes (providing guidelines and support, administrating and coordinating the data needed for the process via preparation, corrections, loads, managing functional and technical issues across the process), Contribution to Change Management roadmap as part of support activities, local contribution to end\-user user adoption and continuous feedback.
* Knowledge management through the team and the development of local tools to ensure a high level of support (documentation, knowledge sharing), contribution to knowledge transfer and education of first levels of support (Employee Contact Center, P\&C Partners, HR Data Management teams). Cooperate transversally to serve as a liaison between People Services and Digital to provide systems support and analysis to leverage technology solutions to meet the needs of end users of HR and non\-HR systems
* Work closely with the People Services People Life Cycle GPO team, as well as all stakeholders such as P\&C, R\&P, Talent Acquisition, Internal Control, Digital Operations, to ensure constant alignment. Work closely with the Captive Centers in the management of Support \& Service Requests, and in identifying synergies. Ensure compliance with internal control requirements of Globally defined Model, according to People Services Global Core Model.
* Support DOM (Document Management functionality) by: Creating new documents / updating existing documents using the DocGen functionality. Updating existing documents created with BIRT functionality, Creating/updating new text blocks and connected rules, Creating/coping/updating questionnaire within documents. Identifying issues with calculated fields. Assigning / removing signatory role. Updating text for electronic signature process.
* Support Workday\-connected local integrations. Troubleshoot and liase with Digital team when files fail. Perform impact analysis to any local integration when new configuration is performed. Validate data is flowing and received downstream. Submit request to update the integration. Participate in new integration requests and/or enhancements to existing integrations. Validate data is flowing and received correctly with vendor. Submit request to create the integration/API call. Work with business to document requirements

**About you:**
